messages.content: You are cross-examining other auditors. For EACH finding listed, decide whether it is a real defect in the code shown. Reply with JSON only: {"votes":[{"ref":"<auditor>:<id>","vote":"AGREE|DISAGREE","reason":"..."}],"missed":[{"severity":"...","file":"...","line":0,"issue":"...","evidence":"...","fix":"..."}]}

AUDIT QUESTION: Batch 34 = RULINGS 18 + 19 (orchestrator 2026-11-12 '10:36', '10:51') + ruling 17's cycle-2 boundary fix. Integrity stays fail-closed.
RULING 18: when the run's decode and the pin's approved text differ in a locked span on exactly ONE token (a 1-for-1 replacement), not a number / name / negation (those hold before any vote), and the independent second recogniser reads the RUN's word at that position (an even split), the lock does not hold: it records both attested readings (lock['alternatives']: token_index, readings, the run word's index and source time span) and its digest is recomputed (pinned.adjudicate_lock). Two or more differences, or a reading of neither, still HOLD. G18 (word_diff.gate_g18) for such a lock: the final's decode may read EITHER attested reading at that position (edges() and diff() with alts; any other difference fails), its identity reference is the lock text, AND the token's audio must be the source's: sentence_law.span_fidelity = G17c's frame comparison (every 10 ms source frame above the floor within EDGE_WORD_MAX_DB 1.0 dB, best of +-2 hops, every kept frame compared) on the PREPARED clip over the token's span; the same on the final bytes is recorded as evidence only (the music bed and loudnorm make a 1 dB frame test impossible there). A mismatch fails G18. RULING 19: the comparison floor for G17c AND the token check is EDGE_WORD_FLOOR_DBFS = -90 dBFS (was -96): measured AAC codec noise at -92.9 / -94.2 dBFS in a pause (1.22 dB apart) while every frame above -90 was within 0.52 dB. Ruling 17 cycle-2 F1: at the span's start / end (no neighbour) the second recogniser's reading must begin / end exactly there.
Tests: either reading passes on the untouched prepared clip; a third word fails; the token's audio 3 dB down or silenced fails; 'can'/'can't', '15'/'50', 'one'/'two' hold; two ambiguous tokens hold; a start-of-span difference read with an extra word holds; codec-like noise between -96 and -90 passes, a real 3 dB onset loss at -50 fails.
FIND: any way G18 passes a final whose words differ from the lock other than the one attested alternative; any way the token check passes with the token's audio changed above -90 dBFS; index errors mapping the alternative (canon index vs G18's norm index, edges at the start / end); a critical (number / name / negation) difference that reaches alternatives; tests that do not test what they claim. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.

THIS PART of the diff: pipeline/sentence_law.py only (the rest is audited separately). Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.

index 7e23f5eb..76d8d028 100644
--- a/pipeline/sentence_law.py

                             # level at the cut point (the valley minimum or the room tone the cut sits in)

-EDGE_WORD_FLOOR_DBFS = -96.0   # ruling 16 ('10:20'): G17c compares a frame only above max(the gap level, the 16-bit floor)
+EDGE_WORD_FLOOR_DBFS = -90.0   # rulings 16 / 18 / 19: G17c and the ruling-18 token check compare a frame only above
+                               # max(the gap level, this floor). Ruling 19 ('10:51'): -96 dBFS is the 16-bit floor of a LOSSLESS
+                               # signal, but prepared clips are AAC: measured 2026-11-12 on run pinned_20261112_135315,
+                               # clip_01 (c1JGheQBPH4), a pause frame at source 15.14 s: source -92.9 dBFS, prepared AAC clip
+                               # -94.2 dBFS (1.22 dB apart, codec noise); every frame above -90 dBFS of that span within 0.52 dB.
 
 
 def edge_word_bounds(sa, plan, cut_in, cut_out):
@@ -841,6 +845,31 @@ def apply_lead_in_pad(run_dir, cut, fps, qp):
     return {"pad_s": pad, "room_tone_source_s": info, "wav": os.path.basename(wav)}
 
 
+def span_fidelity(src_path, clip_path, t0, t1, cut_in, pad_s=0.0, sa=None, offset_s=0.0):
+    """Ruling 18: the source span [t0, t1] is the clip's audio, frame for frame: G17c's comparison (every 10 ms source
+    frame above EDGE_WORD_FLOOR_DBFS within EDGE_WORD_MAX_DB in the clip, at the best of +-2 hops, every kept frame
+    compared). offset_s: where the clip starts inside clip_path (0 for a prepared clip). Returns (ok, detail)."""
+    sa = sa or SourceAudio(src_path)
+    ca = SourceAudio(clip_path)
+    base = offset_s - cut_in + pad_s
+    _, ds = sa.sl(t0, t1)
+    keep = ds > EDGE_WORD_FLOOR_DBFS
+    if not keep.any():
+        return False, {"span": [round(t0, 3), round(t1, 3)], "why": "no audible source frame in the span"}
+    best = None
+    for k in range(-2, 3):
+        _, dc = ca.sl(t0 + base + k * HOP_S, t1 + base + k * HOP_S)
+        n = min(len(dc), len(ds))
+        if n == 0 or keep[n:].any():                                 # a source frame left uncompared: no proof
+            continue
+        worst = float(np.max(np.abs(dc[:n] - ds[:n])[keep[:n]]))
+        if best is None or worst < best[0]:
+            best = (worst, k)
+    ok = best is not None and best[0] <= EDGE_WORD_MAX_DB
+    return ok, {"span": [round(t0, 3), round(t1, 3)], "worst_db": None if best is None else round(best[0], 2),
+                "shift_hops": None if best is None else best[1], "compared_frames": int(keep.sum())}
+
+
 def gate_g17_edges(run_dir, source_path_fn=None):
     """G17c (law L-b): every machine-cut segment's prepared clip keeps its first and last word, with their
     natural decay, at full level against the source (edge_word_fidelity). Human PIN tables are measured too.
